welcome.headline: Welcome to Quorum — Your Virtual Accounting & Analytics Firm
welcome.subheadline: Upload your data and we'll do the rest. Our team of specialized agents works together to transform messy data into professional, trustworthy analysis.

uploading.title: Processing Your File
uploading.message: Our Researcher is reading your file...
uploading.detail: We support CSV, XLSX, and XLS formats up to 50MB.

profiling.title: Profiling Your Data
profiling.message: Our Researcher is profiling your data — analyzing schema, statistics, and patterns.
profiling.detail: This usually takes just a moment. Refresh the page to check.

preview_ready.title: Free Preview Ready
preview_ready.message: Your data profile is complete. Review the findings at no cost.
preview_ready.detail: See schema overview, column statistics, null analysis, and potential issues.

analysis_started.title: Analysis In Progress
analysis_started.message: The firm has been hired! Our agents are working through your data now.

researcher_done.title: Researcher Complete
researcher_done.message: Researcher has finished ingesting and profiling your data.
researcher_done.detail: Raw data loaded, schema extracted, reference data pulled.

analyst_working.title: Analyst at Work
analyst_working.message: Analyst is finding patterns and detecting anomalies in your data.
analyst_working.detail: Performing exploratory data analysis, computing metrics and KPIs.

analyst_done.title: Analyst Complete
analyst_done.message: Analyst has finished pattern recognition and anomaly detection.
analyst_done.detail: Key metrics calculated, outliers identified, hypotheses generated.

auditor_working.title: Auditor Reviewing
auditor_working.message: Auditor is validating and cleaning the data.

auditor_done.title: Auditor Complete
auditor_done.message: Auditor has finished validation and cleaning.
auditor_done.detail: Corrections logged with full audit trail. Everything is reconcilable.

manager_working.title: Manager Synthesizing
manager_working.message: Manager is adjudicating findings and building your deliverable.
manager_working.detail: Resolving conflicts between Analyst and Auditor, preparing the Excel workbook.

manager_done.title: Manager Complete
manager_done.detail: Decision memo written, professional Excel workbook generated.

workbook_ready.title: Analysis Complete!
workbook_ready.message: Your professional Excel workbook is ready for download.
workbook_ready.detail: Contains: cleaned data sheet, full analysis, audit trail, and decision memo.

all_complete.headline: Your Results Are Ready
all_complete.subheadline: All agents have completed their work. Your deliverables are below.

in_progress.headline: The Firm Is Working
in_progress.subheadline: Our team of agents is processing your data. Progress is shown below.

session_not_found.headline: Session Not Found
session_not_found.message: This session doesn't exist or has expired.

workbook_not_ready.headline: Workbook Not Ready
workbook_not_ready.message: The workbook hasn't been generated yet. Please wait for all agents to complete their work.

upload_failed.headline: Upload Failed
upload_failed.message: We couldn't process your file. Please try again.

payment_failed.headline: Payment Failed
payment_failed.message: The transaction was not completed. No charges were made.
